name: Molaris
tagline: The operations layer for dental groups that outgrew spreadsheets and blind faith.
positioning: Molaris runs scheduling, claims, and chair utilization across every location so your DSO stops leaking revenue between the front desk and the ledger.

hero.h1: Your chairs are empty. Your front desk swears they're booked.
hero.sub: Molaris connects scheduling, claims, and utilization across every location, so leadership sees where the money actually went instead of what the whiteboard claims.

features.title: Chair-hour accounting
features.description: Every operatory, every location, priced by the minute. Find the chairs that quietly lost you $40k last quarter while everyone insisted they were slammed.

features.title: Claims that don't bounce
features.description: We scrub every claim against payer rules before it leaves the building. Fewer denials, fewer 90-day-old receivables nobody wants to own.

features.title: One schedule, forty offices
features.description: Consolidate booking across the whole group without forcing every practice onto the same PMS. Molaris reads what they already use.

features.title: Recall that actually recalls
features.description: Automated hygiene reminders that stop when the patient books and don't text them four times in an afternoon like an anxious ex.

features.title: Provider productivity, honestly
features.description: Per-provider production, no-show cost, and case acceptance ranked without the flattering spin the monthly PDF usually applies.

features.title: Audit-ready compliance
features.description: HIPAA logs, credential expirations, and radiograph retention tracked in one place, so a surprise audit is boring instead of terrifying.

testimonials.quote: We found three locations billing hygiene under the wrong provider for eight months. Molaris flagged it in the first week. That report paid for the whole contract, twice.
testimonials.name: Dana Reinholt

testimonials.quote: I stopped asking office managers how utilization looked and started reading the dashboard. Turns out 'we're totally full' meant 61 percent. We fixed it.
testimonials.name: Marcus Idowu

testimonials.quote: Claim denials dropped from 14 percent to under 4. My AR team went from firefighting to actually going home at five. Nobody misses the fax machine.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkatasubramanian

pricing.blurb: For emerging groups stitching together their first handful of locations.
For scaling DSOs that need one source of truth across the org.
For national groups with procurement teams and real security reviews.

homepage.footerBlurb: Molaris is the operations layer for multi-location dental groups. Less faith, more numbers. Built for the people who actually own the P&L.
